question: What is Iyer's record against Hazlewood?

    p1.player_name AS "Player Name",
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS "Total Runs",
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS "Balls Faced",
    COUNT(FD.fielder_id) AS "Dismissals"

question: Shepherd ਦੇ ਓਵਰ  19-20  ਵਿਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਆਂਕੜੇ  ਦੱਸੋ  (ਰਨ , ਗੇਂਦਾ , ਆਊਟ , ਸਤ੍ਰੀਕੇ ਰੇਟ , ਚੌਕੇ ਤੇ ਛਕੇ )।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS "Runs",
  COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Balls",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_out_id = T2.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dismissals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fours",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Sixes",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Strike_Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'R Shepherd%' AND T1.over_number >= 18 AND NOT (
    T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL
  );

question: List all batsmen with at least 1000 runs against any team in ipl.

SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS "Final Wins" 
FROM Players p 
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id 
JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id 
WHERE m.match_type_number = 1 AND m.gender = 'men' AND m.season LIKE 'IPL%' 
GROUP BY p.player_id 
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) DESC 
LIMIT 5

question: ਕਿਹੜੇ IPL ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਓਵਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਸਨ ਅਤੇ ਓ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.season, CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs) AS REAL) * 6 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS runs_per_over FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id GROUP BY T2.season ORDER BY runs_per_over DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:

    M.season AS Season,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) / SUM(D.ball_number) AS Runs_Per_Over
FROM 
    Deliveries D
JOIN

WHERE 
    D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 AND D.match_type_number = 1 AND D.ball_number > 0
GROUP BY

question: How many matches have been won by mumbai in ahmedabad?List both the teams with their scores.

question: कम से कम 50 मैच खेल चुके गेंदबाज़ों में से, उन गेंदबाज़ों के नाम बताएँ जिन्होंने सबसे ज़्यादा मैचों में कम से कम एक विकेट लिया है।
gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, COUNT(T1.match_id) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, bowler_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')) AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) >= 50) GROUP BY T2.player_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.match_id) DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:

  p.player_name AS "Player Name",
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wickets Taken
FROM 
  Players p
  JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) >= 50
ORDER BY 
  Wickets Taken DESC;

question: List all instances of a knockout match where a team scored 200+ but none of the players scored a half century.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC

  M.start_date AS Match_Date,
  M.venue AS Venue,

  SUM(D.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs

  Matches M
  JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
  M.result_type = 'knockout'
  AND M.result_margin IS NOT NULL
  AND D.wides = 0
  AND D.noballs = 0
  AND D.striker_id NOT IN (

question: Out of bowlers who have played atleat 50 matches, list the bowlers who have the most instances of taking atleast one wicket in a match.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, COUNT(T1.match_id) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, bowler_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')) AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) >= 50) GROUP BY T2.player_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.match_id) DESC LIMIT 5

    P.player_name AS Player_Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT D.delivery_id) AS Wickets_Taken
FROM 
    Deliveries D
JOIN 
    Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN 
    Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id

    P.player_name

    COUNT(DISTINCT D.delivery_id) > 0 AND

    D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
ORDER BY 
    Wickets_Taken DESC

question: నాకౌట్ మ్యాచులలో 200 కంటే ఎక్కువ పరుగులు చేసినా టీం లో అందరూ కనీసం 50 పరుగులు చెయ్యని అన్నీ ఉదాహరణలు రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  M.start_date AS Match_Date,
  M.venue AS Venue,
  D.batting_team AS Batting_Team,
  SUM(D.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs
FROM 
  Matches M
  JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
  M.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND M.result_type = 'win'
  AND D.wides = 0
  AND D.noballs = 0
  AND D.ball_number = 60
  AND D.striker_id IN (
    SELECT 
      P.player_id
    FROM 
      PlayerInMatch PIM
      JOIN Players P ON P.player_id = PIM.player_id
    WHERE 
      PIM.team_name = M.team1
      AND PIM.match_id = M.match_id
      AND P.player_name IN (
        SELECT 
          P2.player_name
        FROM 
          Players P2
          JOIN Deliveries D2 ON P2.player_id = D2.striker_id
        WHERE 
          D2.match_id = M.match_id
          AND D2.inning = 1
          AND D2.runs_scored > 200
      )
  )
  AND D.striker_id NOT IN (
    SELECT 
      P3.player_id
    FROM 
      FielderDismissals FD
      JOIN Players P3 ON P3.player_id = FD.fielder_id
    WHERE 
      FD.delivery_id = D.delivery_id
      AND FD.fielder_id IN (
        SELECT 
          P4.player_id
        FROM 
          Players P4
          JOIN Deliveries D4 ON P4.player_id = D4.striker_id
        WHERE 
          D4.match_id = M.match_id
          AND D4.inning = 1
          AND D4.runs_scored > 200
      )
      AND P3.player_name IN (
        'run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field'
      )
  )
GROUP BY 
  M.match_id

gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "balls_played" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" >= 16 GROUP BY T3."player_name" ORDER BY "total_runs" DESC LIMIT 1;

    p.player_name AS Player_Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls_Played

    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

    PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id

    WHEN (T1.toss_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'bat') OR (T1.toss_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'field')
    THEN 'Batting First'
    ELSE 'Fielding First'

  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "Matches_Played",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Wins",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Losses"
FROM "Matches" AS T1

GROUP BY
  "MI_Action";

question: IPL 2025 में, 7 से 15 ओवर के बीच Bumrah के गेंदबाज़ी के आँकड़े दिखाइए।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / 6.0 AS "Overs Bowled",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1."delivery_id"), 0) AS "Economy Rate",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Average",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T3."player_name" = 'JJ Bumrah' AND T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" BETWEEN 6 AND 14;

question: Show players with the most 25-plus scores in Men’s T20 competitions.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  p."player_name",
  COUNT(ps."striker_id") AS "num_25_plus_scores"
FROM PlayerScores AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p
  ON ps."striker_id" = p."player_id"
WHERE
  ps."total_runs" >= 25
GROUP BY
  p."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_25_plus_scores" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    P.player_name AS "Player Name",
    COUNT(DISTINCT D.delivery_id) AS "Number of 25+ Scores"
FROM 
    Deliveries D
JOIN 
    Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN 
    Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id
WHERE 
    M.gender = 'men' AND M.match_type_number = 20 AND D.runs_scored >= 25
GROUP BY 
    P.player_name

question: IPL में 300 या उससे ज़्यादा छक्के लगाने वाले खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताएं।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T2."player_name" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 300 ORDER BY COUNT(T1."delivery_id") DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS Player_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS Total_Sixes 
FROM Deliveries d 
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id 
WHERE m.season = 'IPL' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND d.ball_number = 6 GROUP BY p.player_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) >= 300

question: ਪੁਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ T20 ਮੁਕਾਬਲਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ 25 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਕੋਰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਿਖਾਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  p."player_name",
  COUNT(ps."striker_id") AS "num_25_plus_scores"
FROM PlayerScores AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p
  ON ps."striker_id" = p."player_id"
WHERE
  ps."total_runs" >= 25
GROUP BY
  p."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_25_plus_scores" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS Number_of_25_Scores 
FROM Players p 
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id 
JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id 
WHERE m.gender = 'male' AND m.match_type_number = 20 AND d.runs_scored >= 25 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 
GROUP BY p.player_name

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ 300 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T2."player_name" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 300 ORDER BY COUNT(T1."delivery_id") DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS "Total Sixes" 
FROM Deliveries d 
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id 
WHERE m.season = 'IPL' AND d.wicket_type = 'six' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 
GROUP BY p.player_name 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) >= 300

question: IPL ప్లేఆఫ్స్‌్‌్‌ లో MI యొక్క అత్యాధికా పరుగుల సాధించిన ఓపెనింగ్ జంటలు ఏవరు?
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.match_id,
    T2.inning
  FROM Matches AS T1
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    T1.stage <> 'Group' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    MIN(delivery_id) AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    match_id,
    inning
), Opening_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    SUM(T3.runs_scored + T3.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Innings AS T1
  LEFT JOIN First_Wicket_Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T1.inning = T2.inning
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T3
    ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T1.inning = T3.inning
  WHERE
    T3.delivery_id < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning
), Opening_Batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    striker_id,
    non_striker_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    over_number = 0 AND ball_number = 1
)
SELECT
  p1.player_name AS "Batsman 1",
  p2.player_name AS "Batsman 2",
  op.partnership_runs AS "Partnership Runs",
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS "Opponent",
  m.match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Opening_Partnerships AS op
INNER JOIN Opening_Batsmen AS ob
  ON op.match_id = ob.match_id AND op.inning = ob.inning
INNER JOIN Matches AS m
  ON op.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p1
  ON ob.striker_id = p1.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p2
  ON ob.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('LMP Simmons', 'PA Patel', 90, 'Chennai Super Kings', '2015-05-19')", "('RG Sharma', 'JM Bairstow', 84, 'Gujarat Titans', '2025-05-30')", "('AC Blizzard', 'SR Tendulkar', 81, 'Kolkata Knight Riders', '2011-05-25')", "('LMP Simmons', 'MEK Hussey', 76, 'Chennai Super Kings', '2014-05-28')", "('DR Smith', 'AP Tare', 70, 'Rajasthan Royals', '2013-05-24')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS Batsman 1,
    p2.player_name AS Batsman 2,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS Partnership Runs,
    m.team2 AS Opponent,
    m.start_date AS Match Date
FROM Deliveries D
JOIN Matches m ON D.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim1 ON D.match_id = pim1.match_id AND pim1.player_id = D.striker_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON D.match_id = pim2.match_id AND pim2.player_id = D.non_striker_id
JOIN Players p1 ON pim1.player_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON pim2.player_id = p2.player_id
WHERE m.team1 = 'MI' AND D.inning = 1 AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 AND D.ball_number = 1
GROUP BY p1.player_name, p2.player_name, m.team2, m.start_date
ORDER BY SUM(D.runs_scored) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Show teams that used the same top three batters in all league matches of an IPL season.
gold_sql:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."batting_team",
    T1."striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."batting_team" ORDER BY T1.first_ball_faced) AS batting_position
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_ball_faced
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id"
  ) AS T1
), MatchTop3Lineup AS (
  SELECT
    M."season",
    B."batting_team",
    GROUP_CONCAT(B."striker_id" ORDER BY B.batting_position) AS top_3_batters
  FROM BattingOrder AS B
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON B.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE
    B.batting_position <= 3 AND M."stage" = 'Group'
  GROUP BY
    M."season",
    B.match_id,
    B."batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT(B."striker_id") = 3
)
SELECT
  "season",
  "batting_team"
FROM MatchTop3Lineup
GROUP BY
  "season",
  "batting_team"
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT top_3_batters) = 1 AND COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
  "season" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.season AS Season, T2.batting_team AS Batting_Team
FROM Matches T1
JOIN (
  SELECT batting_team, inning, striker_id, non_striker_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1 AND match_id IN (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season = 'IPL'
  )
  GROUP BY batting_team, inning, striker_id, non_striker_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE inning = 1 AND match_id IN (
      SELECT match_id
      FROM Matches
      WHERE season = 'IPL'
    )
  ) / 3
) T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id

question: IPL 2025 में GT के बल्लेबाज़ी औसत और स्ट्राइक रेट की तुलना MI के गेंदबाज़ी औसत, स्ट्राइक रेट, और इकोनॉमी रेट से करें।
gold_sql: WITH GT_Batting AS (SELECT CAST(SUM("runs_scored") AS REAL) AS gt_total_runs, COUNT("player_out_id") AS gt_dismissals, COUNT("delivery_id") AS gt_balls_faced FROM "Deliveries" INNER JOIN "Matches" ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id" WHERE "Matches"."season" = '2025' AND "Deliveries"."batting_team" = 'Gujarat Titans'), MI_Bowling AS (SELECT CAST(SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS REAL) AS mi_runs_conceded, COUNT(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS mi_wickets_taken, COUNT("delivery_id") AS mi_balls_bowled FROM "Deliveries" INNER JOIN "Matches" ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id" WHERE "Matches"."season" = '2025' AND "Deliveries"."bowling_team" = 'Mumbai Indians') SELECT gt_total_runs / gt_dismissals AS "GT Batting Average", gt_total_runs * 100 / gt_balls_faced AS "GT Batting Strike Rate", mi_runs_conceded / mi_wickets_taken AS "MI Bowling Average", CAST(mi_balls_bowled AS REAL) / mi_wickets_taken AS "MI Bowling Strike Rate", mi_runs_conceded * 6 / mi_balls_bowled AS "MI Bowling Economy" FROM GT_Batting, MI_Bowling
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN team_name = 'GT' THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) / 
     COUNT(CASE WHEN team_name = 'GT' THEN delivery_id ELSE NULL END) 
     FROM Deliveries WHERE batting_team = 'GT' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND inning = 1) AS GT_Batting_Average,
    (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN team_name = 'GT' THEN 100.0 * ball_number / (ball_number + 1) ELSE 0 END) 
     FROM Deliveries WHERE batting_team = 'GT' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND inning = 1) AS GT_Batting_Strike_Rate,
    (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN team_name = 'MI' THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) 
     FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'MI' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND inning = 1) AS MI_Bowling_Average,
    (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN team_name = 'MI' THEN 6.0 * (ball_number + 1) / ball_number ELSE 0 END) 
     FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'MI' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND inning = 1) AS MI_Bowling_Strike_Rate,
    (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN team_name = 'MI' THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) / (ball_number + 1) 
     FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'MI' AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND inning = 1) AS MI_Bowling_Economy;

question: List the top 5 bowlers with the best economy rate in overs 1–6 in IPL 2025 among those who bowled 15 or more overs.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."bowler_id" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 90 ORDER BY economy ASC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:

  p.player_name AS Player_Name,
  SUM(DATEDIFF(SUBSTR(d.end_date, 1, 4), SUBSTR(d.start_date, 1, 4)) * 365 + 
       DATEDIFF(SUBSTR(d.end_date, 6, 2), SUBSTR(d.start_date, 6, 2)) * 30 + 
       DATEDIFF(SUBSTR(d.end_date, 9, 2), SUBSTR(d.start_date, 9, 2))) * 1.0 / 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.ball_number <= 30 THEN d.delivery_id END) AS Economy
FROM 
  Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
  m.season = 'IPL 2025' AND d.inning = 1 AND d.ball_number <= 30 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) >= 15
ORDER BY 
  Economy
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL లో PBKS కి వెతిరేకంగా Virat Kohli యొక్క మొత్తం మీద బ్యాటింగ్ రికార్డు ఏమిటి - మ్యాచూలు, పరుగులు, ఆవెరేజ్, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, శతకాలు మరియు అర్ధశతకాలు.
gold_sql:
WITH KohliMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS runs,
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS balls
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), KohliDismissals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dismissals
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."player_out_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(T1."match_id") AS "Matches",
  SUM(T1.runs) AS "Runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) / T2.dismissals AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.balls) AS "Strike Rate",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Centuries",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 50 AND T1.runs < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fifties"
FROM KohliMatchRuns AS T1, KohliDismissals AS T2;

question: List the top 5 highest scores from No.6 or lower in successful IPL run-chases
gold_sql:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS batting_position
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
), PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "batting_team"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2.total_runs,
  T4."venue",
  T4."match_date"
FROM BattingOrder AS T1
INNER JOIN PlayerScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T1."match_id" = T4."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.inning = 2 AND T1.batting_position >= 6 AND T2.batting_team = T4.match_winner
ORDER BY
  T2.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: रन-चेज़ में RCB के लिए पाँचवें विकेट या उसके बाद के लिए सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी कौन सी है? इस साझेदारी में शामिल बल्लेबाज़ों के नाम भी बताइए।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Deliveries D1
JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM1 ON D1.match_id = PIM1.match_id AND PIM1.player_id = D1.striker_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM2 ON D1.match_id = PIM2.match_id AND PIM2.player_id = D1.non_striker_id
JOIN Players P1 ON PIM1.player_id = P1.player_id
JOIN Players P2 ON PIM2.player_id = P2.player_id

AND D1.inning > 1
AND D1.wides = 0

GROUP BY D1.match_id, P1.player_name, P2.player_name

WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",

    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"

  JOIN "Matches" AS M

  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'

  FROM PartnershipGroups

question: రన్ చేసులలో RCB యొక్క ఐదవ వికెట్ లేదా దాని తరవాత అత్యధిక భాగస్వామ్యం ఏమిటి? ఈ బ్యాట్స్మెన్ల పేరులు ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT SUM(D1.runs_scored) AS Partnership Runs, P1.player_name AS Batsman 1 Name, P2.player_name AS Batsman 2 Name
FROM Deliveries D1
JOIN Deliveries D2 ON D1.match_id = D2.match_id AND D1.inning = D2.inning AND D1.over_number = D2.over_number AND D1.ball_number = D2.ball_number + 1
JOIN Players P1 ON D1.striker_id = P1.player_id
JOIN Players P2 ON D2.striker_id = P2.player_id
JOIN Matches M ON D1.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch PM ON M.match_id = PM.match_id AND PM.team_name = 'RCB'
WHERE D1.wides = 0 AND D1.noballs = 0 AND D2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY P1.player_name, P2.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(D1.runs_scored) DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Find the top 5 players with the highest strike rates who scored atleast 400 runs in an ipl season.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "strike_rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS Player_Name,
  m.season AS Season,
  SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
  (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / (d.ball_number * 6)) AS Strike_Rate
FROM 
  Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
  JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
  d.ball_number > 0 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.runs_scored > 0 AND m.season LIKE 'IPL%' AND d.inning = 1
GROUP BY 
  p.player_id, m.season
HAVING 
  SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 400
ORDER BY 
  Strike_Rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ਉਹਨਾਂ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਲੱਭੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਇੱਕ IPL ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 400 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ ਸਨ।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "strike_rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

  T1."season",
  T1."venue",
  T2.inning1_score + 1 AS target,
  T1."match_winner" AS chasing_team
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS inning1_score
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"

  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS inning2_score
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
) AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."city" = 'Jaipur' AND T2.inning1_score >= 199 AND T3.inning2_score > T2.inning1_score;

question: IPL 2025 ਦੇ ਆਖਰੀ 5 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 25 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ) ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਨ, ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਸਮੇਤ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced, (SUM(T1.runs_scored) * 100.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id WHERE T3.season = '2025' AND T1.over_number >= 15 GROUP BY T2.player_name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 25 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 5

    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS "Total Runs",
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS "Balls Faced",
    (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0) / SUM(d.ball_number) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
JOIN

WHERE 
    m.season = 'IPL 2025' AND d.ball_number BETWEEN 76 AND 100
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0) / SUM(d.ball_number) DESC
LIMIT 5

question: IPL 2025 లో చివరి 5 ఓవర్లలో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి (కనెసం 25 బంతులు)? టాప్ 5 క్రీడాకార్ల పేరులు, ఆడిన బంతులు మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced, (SUM(T1.runs_scored) * 100.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id WHERE T3.season = '2025' AND T1.over_number >= 15 GROUP BY T2.player_name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 25 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player_Name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
    SUM(d.ball_number) AS Balls_Faced,
    (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / SUM(d.ball_number)) AS Strike_Rate
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id

    m.season = 'IPL 2025'
    AND d.over_number >= 16
    AND d.ball_number >= 1
    AND d.ball_number <= 25
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0

    p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    Strike_Rate DESC
LIMIT 5

question: ఏ టాప్ 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఒక ఫ్రాంఛైజీ కోసం 2 ఆటల మాజ్జిలో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఆటలు ఆడలేదు?
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchDates AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."team_name",
    T2."match_date"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "team_name",
    "match_date",
    LEAD("match_date", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "team_name" ORDER BY "match_date") AS "next_match_date"
  FROM PlayerMatchDates
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T1."team_name",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(T2."match_id")
    FROM "Matches" AS T2
    WHERE
      (
        T2."team1" = T1."team_name" OR T2."team2" = T1."team_name"
      )
      AND T2."match_date" > T1."match_date"
      AND T2."match_date" < T1."next_match_date"
  ) AS "missed_matches"
FROM PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."next_match_date" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  "missed_matches" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: List the top 5 players, between 2 appearances of whom a franchise played the most number of matches.
gold_sql:
WITH FranchiseMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE "team_name"
    END AS "franchise_name"
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"
  FROM FranchiseMatches
), PlayerAppearanceSequence AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."franchise_name",
    T2."franchise_match_seq"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN FranchiseMatchNumbers AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."franchise_name" = CASE
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team_name"
    END
), AppearanceGaps AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "franchise_name",
    "franchise_match_seq" - LAG("franchise_match_seq", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "franchise_name" ORDER BY "franchise_match_seq") AS "gap"
  FROM PlayerAppearanceSequence
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."franchise_name",
  T4."gap" - 1 AS "matches_missed"
FROM AppearanceGaps AS T4
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T4."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T4."gap" > 1
ORDER BY
  "matches_missed" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ਕਿਸੇ ਫ੍ਰੈਂਚਾਇਜ਼ੀ ਲਈ 2 ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਮੈਚ ਮਿਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਖਿਡਾਰੀ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchDates AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."team_name",
    T2."match_date"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "team_name",
    "match_date",
    LEAD("match_date", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "team_name" ORDER BY "match_date") AS "next_match_date"
  FROM PlayerMatchDates
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T1."team_name",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(T2."match_id")
    FROM "Matches" AS T2
    WHERE
      (
        T2."team1" = T1."team_name" OR T2."team2" = T1."team_name"
      )
      AND T2."match_date" > T1."match_date"
      AND T2."match_date" < T1."next_match_date"
  ) AS "missed_matches"
FROM PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."next_match_date" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  "missed_matches" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ పార్ట్నర్షిప్ ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్న 4 జతలు (కనీసం 1000 పరుగులు) ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipData AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants'
), PartnershipPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group,
    MIN("striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id") AS p2_id,
    SUM(total_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM PartnershipData
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T3."player_name",
  T1.partnership_runs

JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1.p1_id = T2."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1.p2_id = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.wicket_group >= 1
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC

question: एक सीज़न में 25 या उससे कम गेंदों में सबसे ज़्यादा बार पचासा (50 रन) लगाने वाले 3 बल्लेबाज़।
gold_sql:
WITH BatsmanInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT (
        T1."extra_runs" > 0
        AND T1."runs_scored" = 0
        AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BallsToFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    MIN("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_taken"
  FROM BatsmanInnings
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season"
), FastFifties AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season"
  FROM BallsToFifty
  WHERE
    "balls_taken" <= 25
), SeasonCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    COUNT(*) AS "num_fast_fifties"
  FROM FastFifties
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "season"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."season",
  T1."num_fast_fifties"
FROM SeasonCounts AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."num_fast_fifties" DESC
LIMIT 3;

gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1

question: highest average by a player against any opponent with atleat 500 runs against them. list the runs strike rate and average.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1

  p.player_name AS Player_Name,
  t.team1 AS Opponent,
  SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
  (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0) / SUM(d.ball_number) AS Strike_Rate,
  (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS Average

gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1

    (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id)) AS "Average"
FROM

question: Top 4 Highest SR for a batter in an IPL season (min. 100 balls faced)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season,
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "StrikeRate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  "StrikeRate" DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: IPL 2025 में मिडिल ओवर्स में सबसे अच्छा स्ट्राइक रेट (SR) (न्यूनतम 75 गेंदें खेली हों)। टॉप 5 की सूची दें।

question: list the number of times each team has chased a total of 200 or more.
gold_sql:
WITH Inning1Scores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "inning1_total"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
), ChasingTeams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1.match_winner
  END AS "team_name",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "successful_chases"
FROM Matches AS T1
JOIN Inning1Scores AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
JOIN ChasingTeams AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T1.match_winner = T3.batting_team AND T2.inning1_total >= 199
GROUP BY
  "team_name"
ORDER BY
  "successful_chases" DESC;
gold_answer: ["('Punjab Kings', 8)", "('Mumbai Indians', 5)", "('Sunrisers Hyderabad', 4)", "('Rajasthan Royals', 4)", "('Chennai Super Kings', 4)", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 3)", "('Lucknow Super Giants', 3)", "('Kolkata Knight Riders', 3)", "('Delhi Capitals', 3)", "('Gujarat Titans', 2)"]

    T1.team1 AS Team_Name,

question: ਹਰੇਕ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਵਾਰ 200 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਦੇ target ਦਾ ਸਫਲਤਾਪੂਰਵਕ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH Inning1Scores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "inning1_total"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
), ChasingTeams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1.match_winner
  END AS "team_name",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "successful_chases"
FROM Matches AS T1
JOIN Inning1Scores AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
JOIN ChasingTeams AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T1.match_winner = T3.batting_team AND T2.inning1_total >= 199
GROUP BY
  "team_name"
ORDER BY
  "successful_chases" DESC;

question: IPL 2025 ਦੇ ਮੱਧ ਓਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਖਿਡਾਰੀ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 75 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ)।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" BETWEEN 6 AND 14 GROUP BY T2."player_name" HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 75 ORDER BY "strike_rate" DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS "Player Name",
  SUM(DATEDIFF(SUBSTR(d.start_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(d.start_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(d.start_date, 9, 2), SUBSTR(d.end_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(d.end_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(d.end_date, 9, 2)) * 24 * 60 * 60 + 
  (CASE 
     WHEN d.ball_number = 1 THEN 0
     ELSE (d.ball_number - 1)
  END) * 60 * 60 + 
  (CASE 
     WHEN d.ball_number = 1 THEN 0
     ELSE (d.ball_number - 1)
  END) * 60 + 
  (CASE 
     WHEN d.ball_number = 1 THEN 0
     ELSE (d.ball_number - 1)
  END) AS total_minutes,
  SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
  COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS total_deliveries
FROM 
  Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
  JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
  m.season = 'IPL 2025' AND d.inning = 1 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.ball_number > 1
GROUP BY 
  p.player_id
HAVING 
  COUNT(d.delivery_id) >= 75 AND p.player_id IN (
    SELECT 
      striker_id
    FROM 
      Deliveries
    WHERE 
      match_id IN (
        SELECT 
          match_id
        FROM 
          Matches
        WHERE 
          season = 'IPL 2025'
      ) AND inning = 1 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY 
      striker_id
    ORDER BY 
      SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(d.delivery_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
  )
ORDER BY 
  SUM(d.runs_scored) / COUNT(d.delivery_id) DESC
LIMIT 5;

  FROM "Deliveries"
), InningsFifty AS (

    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("balls_faced") AS "balls_to_reach_50"
  FROM CumulativeStats

    "cumulative_runs" >= 50

    "match_id",
    "inning"
)

JOIN Deliveries b ON a.match_id = b.match_id AND a.inning = b.inning AND a.over_number = b.over_number AND a.ball_number + 1 = b.ball_number
JOIN PlayerInMatch c ON a.match_id = c.match_id AND a.player_id = c.player_id
JOIN Matches d ON a.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN Players e ON a.player_id = e.player_id
JOIN Deliveries f ON b.match_id = f.match_id AND b.inning = f.inning AND b.over_number = f.over_number AND b.ball_number = f.ball_number + 1
JOIN PlayerInMatch g ON b.match_id = g.match_id AND b.player_id = g.player_id
JOIN Matches h ON b.match_id = h.match_id
JOIN Players i ON b.player_id = i.player_id
WHERE a.match_id IN ( SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE team1 = 'RR' OR team2 = 'RR' ) 
AND a.match_id IN ( SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE team1 = 'SRH' OR team2 = 'SRH' ) 
AND a.player_id = 'tm head' 
AND a.wicket_type NOT IN ( 'run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field' ) 
AND a.runs_scored >= 50 
AND a.ball_number = ( SELECT MIN(ball_number) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = a.match_id AND player_id = a.player_id AND runs_scored >= 50 )

question: list all instances of 100+ opening stands for lsg.the total runs and the batters involved
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
    OR T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
), OpeningBatsmen AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "delivery_id" IN (
      SELECT
        MIN("delivery_id")
      FROM "Deliveries"
      GROUP BY
        "match_id",
        "inning"
    )
)
SELECT
  T1.partnership_runs,
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
INNER JOIN OpeningBatsmen AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."non_striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.batting_team = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1.partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC;

question: highest partnership to get a 10-wicket win in ipl
gold_sql:
WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "result_type" = 'wickets' AND "result_margin" = 10
), PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), Partners AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  UNION
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."non_striker_id" AS player_id

SELECT
  "batting_team",
  SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
FROM Deliveries
LEFT JOIN FirstWicket
  ON Deliveries.match_id = FirstWicket.match_id AND Deliveries.inning = FirstWicket.inning
WHERE
  (
    CASE
      WHEN "bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')

    END
  ) = 'Delhi Capitals'
  AND (
    Deliveries.delivery_id < FirstWicket.first_wicket_delivery
    OR FirstWicket.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  Deliveries.match_id,
  Deliveries.inning
ORDER BY
  partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 2;

gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
)
SELECT
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name",
  T4."season",
  COUNT(T3."match_id") AS num_50_plus_stands
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T3
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T3."match_id" = T4."match_id"

INNER JOIN "Players" AS T6

WHERE
  T3.partnership_runs > 50

  T4."season",

question: IPL 2025 में DC vs GT वाले मैच में KL Rahul की शतक वाली पारी हर 20 गेंदों के बाद कैसे आगे बढ़ी, यह दिखाओ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "runs_scored",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs_scored"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%'
    ) AND "match_id" = (
      SELECT
        T1."match_id"
      FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
      INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
        ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
      INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
        ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
      WHERE
        T2."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND (
          (
            (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team1"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals' AND T3."team2" = 'Gujarat Titans'
          ) OR (
            T3."team1" = 'Gujarat Titans' AND (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team2"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals'
          )
        )
      GROUP BY
        T1."match_id"
      HAVING
        SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 100
      LIMIT 1
    )
)

  MAX("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_faced",

  "cumulative_balls_faced" > 0

WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "runs_scored",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",

    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs_scored"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%'
    ) AND "match_id" = (
      SELECT
        T1."match_id"
      FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
      INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
        ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
      INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
        ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
      WHERE
        T2."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND (
          (
            (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team1"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals' AND T3."team2" = 'Gujarat Titans'

                WHEN T3."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team2"

question: the 5 most 100+ partnerships for a pair
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    player1_id,
    player2_id
  HAVING
    partnership_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  COUNT(*) AS "num_100_plus_partnerships"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS pr
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON pr.player1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON pr.player2_id = p2."player_id"
GROUP BY
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_100_plus_partnerships" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: एक IPL सीज़न में लक्ष्य का पीछा करते हुए सबसे ज़्यादा हार। ऐसे सभी मौकों की सूची दें।

WITH DefeatCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    CASE
      WHEN "toss_decision" = 'field' THEN "toss_winner"
      WHEN "toss_winner" = "team1" THEN "team2"
      ELSE "team1"
    END AS chasing_team,
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "match_winner" IS NOT NULL
), SeasonDefeats AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    chasing_team,
    COUNT(*) AS num_defeats
  FROM DefeatCounts
  WHERE
    chasing_team <> "match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    "season",
    chasing_team
)
SELECT
  chasing_team,
  "season",
  num_defeats
FROM SeasonDefeats
WHERE
  num_defeats = (
    SELECT
      MAX(num_defeats)
    FROM SeasonDefeats
  )
ORDER BY
  "season";

    team2 AS ChasingTeam,
    season AS Season,
    COUNT(*) AS MaximumDefeats
FROM 
    Matches

    result_type = 'target' AND match_winner = team2
GROUP BY 
    team2, season
ORDER BY 
    MaximumDefeats DESC

gold_sql:
WITH DefeatCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    CASE
      WHEN "toss_decision" = 'field' THEN "toss_winner"
      WHEN "toss_winner" = "team1" THEN "team2"
      ELSE "team1"
    END AS chasing_team,
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "match_winner" IS NOT NULL
), SeasonDefeats AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    chasing_team,
    COUNT(*) AS num_defeats
  FROM DefeatCounts
  WHERE
    chasing_team <> "match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    "season",
    chasing_team
)
SELECT
  chasing_team,
  "season",
  num_defeats
FROM SeasonDefeats
WHERE
  num_defeats = (
    SELECT
      MAX(num_defeats)

question: the 5 highest average run rates over a season by a team in powerplay.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  m.season,
  CASE
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE d.batting_team
  END AS franchise,
  SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / COUNT(
    CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END
  ) AS run_rate
FROM Deliveries AS d
JOIN Matches AS m
  ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  d.over_number <= 5
GROUP BY
  m.season,
  franchise
ORDER BY
  run_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL 2025 ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਜ਼ 50 ਰਨ|
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: IPL 2025 యొక్క అన్నిటికన్నా వేగమైన టీం 50 ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: list bowling stats of Fazalhaq Farooqi in IPL 2025
gold_sql:

  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",

  ) AS "Wickets",

  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

    SUM(D.runs_scored) * 6.0 / SUM(D.over_number + D.ball_number / 10.0) AS Economy_Rate

question: IPL 2025 ਵਿੱਚ Fazalhaq Farooqi ਦੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਕੜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

    SUM(D.ball_number) / 6 AS Overs Bowled,

question: किसी IPL मैच में, 4 से 7 नंबर के बल्लेबाज़ों द्वारा मिलकर बनाए गए सर्वाधिक रनों का रिकॉर्ड बताएं।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."venue",
  T1."batting_team",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "batting_team" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS "batting_position"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."batting_team" = T2."batting_team"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."batting_position" BETWEEN 4 AND 7
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T1."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

        SELECT 
            match_id

            match_type_number = 1
    )
    AND D.ball_number BETWEEN 4 AND 7

        'run out',
        'retired hurt',
        'obstructing the field'
    )
GROUP BY 
    M.venue,
    D.batting_team
ORDER BY 
    TotalRuns DESC

question: IPL की एक पारी में 35 रन से कम पर 3 विकेट गिरने के बाद 5 सबसे बड़े टोटल।
gold_sql:
WITH InningsProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_down",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "current_score"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), QualifyingInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM InningsProgress
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" = 3 AND "current_score" < 35
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS "final_total"
FROM QualifyingInnings AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T2."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "final_total" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL 2025 में Fazalhaq Farooqi के गेंदबाज़ी के आँकड़े बताएं।

SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

SELECT
  T3."venue",
  T1."batting_team",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "batting_team" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS "batting_position"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."batting_team" = T2."batting_team"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."batting_position" BETWEEN 4 AND 7
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T1."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 75 रन या उससे कम के स्कोर पर पहले 5 विकेट गंवाने के बाद, सफलतापूर्वक हासिल किए गए 3 सबसे बड़े लक्ष्यों की सूची दें। टीमों, लक्ष्य (target) और वर्ष का भी उल्लेख करें।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: give the 3 highest targets chased down after losing first 5 wickets for 75 or lower.list the teams, target and the year.
gold_sql:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: Of the matches that were played for 20 overs, list the two highest powerplay score by a team losing five or more wickets in Powerplay in IPL.list the teams, runs in pp, the opponent and the year.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."powerplay_runs",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = T2."team1"
    THEN T2."team2"
    ELSE T2."team1"
  END AS "opponent",
  T2."season"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "powerplay_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT("player_out_id") >= 5
) AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."match_id" IN (
    SELECT
      "match_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      MAX("over_number") >= 19
  )
ORDER BY
  T1."powerplay_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: Highest SR in debut IPL innings (10+ balls)
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM DebutInnings AS T1
JOIN Deliveries AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id" AND T1."debut_match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"

  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10

  strike_rate DESC

  T1."match_id" IN (
    SELECT

question: ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਓਪਨਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਰਫ 0 ਰੰਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਗੁਆਉਣ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ। ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਓਪਨਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."season",
  T1."batting_team",
  T4."player_name",
  T5."player_name"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id" AS opener1,
    "non_striker_id" AS opener2
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
) AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1.opener1 = T4."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T1.opener2 = T5."player_id"
WHERE
  (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener1
  ) = 0
  AND (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener2
  ) = 0
  AND T1.opener1 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  )
  AND T1.opener2 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  );

question: list the 5 highest strike rates of a player with minimum 10 balls played in their debut ipl match.give the player, their runs and balls in that match, teams in that match, and year
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

  m.team1 AS Team_1,
  m.team2 AS Team_2,
  m.season AS Season
FROM

  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

  )

ORDER BY 
  Strike_Rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ਪਲੇਇੰਗ ਇਲੈਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 10 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ)। ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ, ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."match_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."player_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS rn
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS player_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
    SUM("runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."team1" || ' vs ' || T3."team2" AS teams,
  T2.player_score,
  T2.balls_faced,
  T3."season"
FROM DebutMatches AS T1
JOIN BattingStats AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1 AND T2.balls_faced >= 10
ORDER BY
  T2.strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;
